# pve_ceph_pool (Resource)

Ceph pool (replicated or erasure-coded) manageable through the POST/PUT settings surface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_ceph_pool" "example" {
  name = "CHANGE_ME"
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the pool. It must be unique.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `add_storages` (Boolean) Configure VM and CT storage using the new pool. Defaults to false for replicated pools and to true for erasure-coded pools (since EC pools are typically only useful when wired up to storage). (default: 0)
- `application` (String) The application of the pool. (default: rbd) One of: `rbd`, `cephfs`, `rgw`.
- `crush_rule` (String) The rule to use for mapping object placement in the cluster.
- `erasure_coding` (String) Create an erasure coded pool for RBD with an accompaning replicated pool for metadata storage. With EC, the common ceph options 'size', 'min_size' and 'crush_rule' parameters will be applied to the metadata pool.
- `force` (Boolean) If true, destroys pool even if in use (default: 0)
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum number of replicas per object (default: 2)
- `pg_autoscale_mode` (String) The automatic PG scaling mode of the pool. (default: warn) One of: `on`, `off`, `warn`.
- `pg_num` (Number) Number of placement groups. (default: 128)
- `pg_num_min` (Number) Minimal number of placement groups.
- `remove_ecprofile` (Boolean) Remove the erasure code profile. Defaults to true, if applicable. (default: 1)
- `remove_storages` (Boolean) Remove all pveceph-managed storages configured for this pool (default: 0)
- `size` (Number) Number of replicas per object (default: 3)
- `target_size` (String) The estimated target size of the pool for the PG autoscaler.
- `target_size_ratio` (Number) The estimated target ratio of the pool for the PG autoscaler.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/name (also the `terraform import` format).
